heading: top-center
name: 置中標題組跨在交界上＋多圖輪播與頁碼控制列
desc: 置中的標題組往上跨在和上一個區塊的交界上，下方是置中說明文字、一次露出數張橫式圖片的輪播，輪播下方置中放左右箭頭夾著頁碼指示的控制列與一顆按鈕。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊本身不往上移，只有標題組往上移，跨在本區塊和上一個區塊的交界上：小標籤落在上一個區塊的範圍內，大標題的第一行壓在交界線上。本區塊要有自己的實色底色，而且和上一個區塊的底色不同（例如淺色底），交界線才看得出來；區塊上方用區塊內的上方留白（不是外距，也不是負邊距）容納往上移的標題組，這段留白的底色和上一個區塊相同、不能透明，整個區塊從上到下都不能透出底下的內容，也不能蓋到上一個區塊的內容。區塊上方置中放標題組，標題組包含標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤，下方可放副標，沒有時省略；標題明顯大於副標與說明文字。標題組下方隔一段明顯的空白，置中放說明文字，寬約內容寬度的三分之一，沒有時省略。下方是輪播，對齊頁面內容寬度，一次露出四個等寬的項目，每個項目只有一張橫式圖片、無外框，所有圖片同一比例。輪播下方置中放一列控制列：中央是頁碼指示（目前頁碼與總頁數，中間以一條短線相連），左箭頭按鈕和右箭頭按鈕分在頁碼兩側，各和頁碼隔一段明顯的距離，三者不擠成一組，整列約佔內容寬度的三分之一；點擊箭頭時一次切換一整頁。控制列下方可放一顆置中的按鈕，沒有時省略，其他元素的位置不變。
mobile: 標題組與說明文字維持置中，標題仍跨在和上一個區塊的交界上。輪播改為一次露出一個項目，左緣對齊頁面內容寬度，右側露出下一個項目的一部分並延伸到畫面右緣；箭頭改為一次切換一個項目，頁碼的總數隨之變為項目數。控制列仍在輪播下方：頁碼指示置中，左箭頭按鈕靠左、右箭頭按鈕靠右，分別對齊頁面內容寬度的左右兩側；按鈕仍置中排在控制列下方。

en.name: Centered heading group straddling the boundary + multi-image carousel with page-counter controls
en.desc: A centered heading group is pulled up across the boundary with the previous section, followed by a centered description, a carousel showing several landscape images at once, and below it a centered control row of left and right arrows around a page counter plus one button.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. The section itself is not pulled up; only the heading group is moved up so it straddles the boundary between this section and the previous one: the label sits within the previous section and the first line of the headline lies on the boundary line. This section has its own solid background color that differs from the previous section (for example a light tint) so the boundary is visible. The raised heading group sits in this section's own top padding (not an outer margin and not a negative margin); that padding uses the same background color as the previous section and is never transparent, so nothing underneath shows through anywhere in the section and nothing covers the previous section's content. Place the heading group at the top, centered. The heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label above and a subheading below; omit them when there is no content. The title is noticeably larger than the subheading and the description. Below the heading group, after a clearly larger gap, place a centered description about one third of the content width wide; omit it when there is no content. Below that is a carousel aligned with the page content width, showing four equal-width items at once; each item is just a landscape image with no frame, and all images share the same aspect ratio. Below the carousel, place a centered control row: a page counter in the middle (the current page number and the total number of pages, joined by a short line), with the left arrow button and the right arrow button on either side of it, each separated from the counter by a clearly visible gap rather than grouped tightly together; the whole row is about one third of the content width. Clicking an arrow switches a full page at a time. Optionally place one centered button below the control row; omit it when there is no content, without changing the position of the other elements.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: The heading group and description stay centered, and the title still straddles the boundary with the previous section. The carousel shows one item at a time, its left edge aligned with the page content width, with part of the next item visible on the right and extending to the right edge of the viewport; the arrows switch one item at a time and the counter's total changes to the number of items. The control row stays below the carousel: the page counter is centered, the left arrow button is aligned left and the right arrow button aligned right with the page content width; the button stays centered below the control row.
